sanskrit: vyāghrāyobhayādate pathe 'ham akaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: To the tiger that bites on both sides, I have paid homage on the road.

sanskrit: namas te pathye revati svasti mā parā ṇaya svasti punar ā naya | atho svasti nas kṛdhi jīvā jyotir aśīmahi ||
english: Homage to you, O prosperous Pathyā; lead me not away from well-being, bring me back to well-being. Moreover, grant us well-being; may we live and enjoy light.

sanskrit: āmanasaṃ yajāmahe satyaprāśaṃ purohitam | taṃ devaṃ prathamaṃ yaje yo 'mum āmanasaṃ karat ||
english: We worship Āmanasa, the one who eats truth, the household priest. I worship first that god who made this one Āmanasa.

sanskrit: āmanaska devak- -āroruvatka devaka | arvāg avastaraṃ kṛdhi yam ahaṃ kāmaye priyam ||
english: O Āmanaska, O divine one, O divine one who has mounted high — bring him down hither, the beloved one whom I desire.

sanskrit: ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo ayaṃ no vasuvittamaḥ | asyopasadye mā riṣām- -āyaṃ rakṣatu naḥ prajām ||
english: This Agni is our overseer; this one is richest in good things for us. May we not be harmed in approaching him; may he protect our progeny.

sanskrit: asmin sahasraṃ puṣyāsm- -aidhamānāḥ sve gṛhe | imaṃ sam indhiṣīmahy āyuṣmantaḥ suvarcasaḥ ||
english: May we flourish a thousandfold in this, blazing in our own home. May we kindle this fire together, long-lived and of good radiance.

sanskrit: śuddhavālā kṛṣṇaphalā kabrūr balāsabheṣajī | śuktivalgasya nāśanī devī dadātu bheṣajam ||
english: The pure-haired one with dark fruit, the kabrū plant, healer of consumption, destroyer of śuktivalga — may the goddess grant the remedy.

sanskrit: aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi | tatra lohitavṛkṣo jātaḥ śigruḥ kṣiptabheṣajaḥ ||
english: The aśvattha tree is the seat of the gods in the third heaven from here. There was born the red tree, śigru, the swift-acting medicine.

sanskrit: na tatra bhavo hanti na śarva iṣum asyati | yatra tvaṃ deva tumburo parvateṣu virohasi ||
english: There Bhava does not smite, nor does Śarva shoot his arrow — there where you, O god Tumburu, grow upon the mountains.

sanskrit: kṛṣyām anyo vi rohati girer anyo 'dhi pakṣasi | trātārau śaśvatām imāv ā gantāṃ śigrutumburū ||
english: One grows in the cultivated field, the other spreads over the mountain. May these two eternal protectors, Śigru and Tumburu, come here.

sanskrit: yāvat parṇaṃ yāvat phalaṃ yāvanto adhyṛkṣarāḥ | tāvantaḥ śuṣmās tumburos tad u te viṣadūṣaṇam ||
english: As many leaves, as many fruits, as many nodes upon it — so many are the vigors of Tumburu; that indeed is your antidote to poison.

sanskrit: rudra jalāṣabheṣaj- -emaṃ rogam aśīsamo jalāṇiti ||
english: O Rudra, with your cooling medicine — we have calmed this disease with the jalāṇi plant.

sanskrit: asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād idam urv antarikṣam | ṛṣabhasyeva kanikladato hṛdayaṃ śamayāmi te ||
english: Heaven stood firm, the earth stood firm, this broad atmosphere stood firm. Like the heart of a roaring bull, I calm your heart.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ māsau rohiṇī divaḥ | saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
english: May the Maruts sprinkle me; may that Rohiṇī of the sky sprinkle me; may this Agni sprinkle me with offspring and wealth, and make long life for me.

sanskrit: naktaṃ harī mṛgayete divā suparṇarohitau | bhavāya ca śarvāya c- -obhābhyām akaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: By night the two bay horses hunt; by day they are the eagle and the red bird. To Bhava and to Śarva — to both of them I have paid homage.

sanskrit: namo bhavāya namaḥ śarvāya namaḥ kumāraśatrave | namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya namaḥ sabhāprapādine ||
english: Homage to Bhava, homage to Śarva, homage to the foe of the young. Homage to the blue-crested one, homage to the one who strides into the assembly.

sanskrit: yasya harī aśvatarau gardabhāv abhitaḥsarau | tasmai nīlaśikhaṇḍāya namaḥ sabhāprapādine ||
english: To him whose two bay mules, like donkeys, run on both sides — to that blue-crested one, homage to the one who strides into the assembly.

sanskrit: asāv eti śiśumāro asāv eti pulīkayā | kumāraśatro va roh- -odakaṃ parivācanam ||
english: Yonder comes the porpoise, yonder comes it with the pulīka fish. O destroyer of the young, mount — water is the encircling charm.

sanskrit: yathedam abhram arbhakaṃ parjanyād apa śīyate | evā me aśvinā mukhād abhīly apa śīyatām ||
english: Just as this small cloud falls away from Parjanya, so may the abhīlī blemish fall away from my face, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: abhīli naśyetaḥ paras tvacaṃ me mābhi mimlapaḥ | agastyasya brahmaṇ- -ābhīlīṃ nāśayāmasi ||
english: O abhīlī, disappear from here, further away — do not blight my skin. With the prayer of Agastya, we destroy the abhīlī.

sanskrit: sesicām upatvacāṃ nāśay- -ā pururūpād abhīlyaṃ mukhāt ||
english: Destroy the sesicā and upatvacā — drive away the abhīlī of many forms from the face.

sanskrit: yan me kṛtād apriyād āruroha malaṃ mukham | apāṃ vāta iva śīpālaṃ sūryas tad apa lumpatu ||
english: Whatever impurity has climbed onto my face through some hostile deed — may the Sun sweep that away, as the wind sweeps śīpāla from water.

sanskrit: apa me 'bhīlī patatv abhraṃ vātahṛtaṃ yathā | ā mā suvarṇaṃ gacchatu subhāgam astu me mukham ||
english: May the abhīlī fall away from me as a cloud carried off by the wind. May gold come to me; may my face be auspicious.

sanskrit: yathā sūryasyopodaye hiraṇyaṃ pratirocate | evā me aśvinā mukhaṃ suvarṇaṃ prati rocatām ||
english: Just as gold shines at the rising of the sun, so may my face shine with golden color, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: pra yad gāvo na bhūrṇayas tveṣā vayāṃsy akraman | ghnantu kṛṣṇām apa tvacaṃ subhāgam astu me mukham ||
english: When the fierce birds rushed forward like impetuous cattle — let them smite away the dark skin; may my face be auspicious.

sanskrit: indreṇa preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: Sent by Indra, O owl — I cook you together.

sanskrit: somena preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: Sent by Soma, O owl — I cook you together.

sanskrit: sūryeṇa preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: Sent by Sūrya, O owl — I cook you together.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatinā preṣita ulūkāsaṃ pacāmi te ||
english: Sent by Bṛhaspati, O owl — I cook you together.

sanskrit: prajāpatinā preṣita ulūkāsaṃ pacāmi te ||
english: Sent by Prajāpati, O owl — I cook you together.
